title: Addressing the Review coordinator
description: How to write for a reader acting as Review coordinator. One rule, moved out of the role's own `voice` field (#1168): a voice points at the role it addresses, so the role names no voice and a second voice for the same reader is added without editing the role.

sources.title: Role `review-coordinator` — its persona, in the cat-harness role graph

rules.title: Counts, with what each count is and is not
rules.description: Counts, with what each count is and is not. 'Four changed blocks in 3.2 have no verdict' is actionable; 'most of it is reviewed' is not.

source.quote: Holding a 300-page change and a handful of reviewers with different expertise. Needs to know where the changes are, who has read what, and what is still open, section by section, without reading every block themselves.
